objective: Discover evidence-backed recurring problems across materially different domains without selecting a direction.
actions: Researched authoritative public sources in consumer-product resale, health-plan directory operations, and federal procurement
Added and scored three candidate problems
Recorded six evidence entries with limitations and falsification tests
hypothesis: Broad public research can surface recurring, actionable problems with authoritative inputs and testable value before a domain is selected.
checks: Confirmed all candidate claims are tied to primary public sources
Checked each candidate includes a current workaround, actionable output, existing alternatives, and a falsification argument
limitations: No user interviews or external validation were performed
Candidate scores are provisional judgments, not measured outcomes
Historical CMS directory accuracy must not be treated as a current national rate
next: Add at least two candidates from new domains and measure CPSC recall identifier coverage before shortlisting.
